reading: The theta-squared law applies a penalty of 65.5 bits over the 58 octaves to production that the measured slope (0.87 +- 0.09) does not support. It is dropped. The replacement band is the family {measured power law, nu-linear, constant}: log2 p in [-61.55, -4.91]. EVERY member of that family misses the 0.39 floor: even the most generous member is the constant p=0.0333, still 5.9x short.
v10n_law: p proportional to theta^2 (slope 2.00 in log p vs log theta)
